title: [Product Bug] Cancellation promotes incorrect guest from waiting list
rootCause: In src/server/store.ts within the cancelByToken function, the waiting list promotion selects the last element of the waiting list array (waiting.at(-1)) instead of the first element (waiting[0] or waiting.at(0)). This causes LIFO (Last-In-First-Out) behavior where the most recently added waiting list guest is promoted rather than the first person who joined the queue.
suggestedFix: In src/server/store.ts inside cancelByToken, change `promoted = waiting.at(-1);` to `promoted = waiting.at(0);` (or `promoted = waiting[0];`).
testToValidate: Cancellation promotes incorrect guest from waiting list
reasoning: When a confirmed registration is cancelled, any open spot should be offered to the earliest guest on the waiting list following a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) queue order. In src/server/store.ts, `registrations.filter(candidate => candidate.status === 'waiting')` produces an array ordered by creation time. Calling `waiting.at(-1)` retrieves the last item in the array (LIFO behavior), promoting the newest waiting list registrant ('Stephen Bennett') instead of the oldest ('To Be Promoted'). Replacing `waiting.at(-1)` with `waiting.at(0)` correctly promotes the first guest on the waiting list.
